text: It appears you may have inadvertently ingested amphetamines, perhaps through contaminated supplements or food, given the positive toxicology screen. I need to ensure your safety; are you currently experiencing any muscle rigidity, confusion, or signs of overheating?

text: Since you are alert and not showing signs of severe toxicity like rigidity or hyperthermia, this appears to be acute amphetamine intoxication rather than a life-threatening emergency. I will monitor your vital signs closely and provide a calm environment to help you de-escalate.
